9 listings match "github", showing the first 5. Call get_server with a slug for the endpoint URL or install command and setup steps.
- DeepWiki (Cognition): Ask questions about any public GitHub repository and read its AI-generated DeepWiki documentation. [slug deepwiki; remote, no sign-in; verified] https://mcp.tc/i/deepwiki
- GitHub: Work with GitHub repos, issues, pull requests, Actions workflows and code search from your AI assistant. [slug github; remote, OAuth sign-in; verified] https://mcp.tc/i/github
- GitMCP: Read documentation and search code of any GitHub repository, so answers come from the current source instead of model memory. [slug gitmcp; remote, no sign-in] https://mcp.tc/i/gitmcp
- Grep by Vercel (Vercel): Search real code across a million public GitHub repositories with literal and regex patterns. [slug grep; remote, no sign-in; verified] https://mcp.tc/i/grep
- Awesome Copilot (Microsoft): Retrieve GitHub Copilot customization files from the Awesome Copilot repository, such as prompts, instructions and chat modes. [slug awesome-copilot; runs locally] https://mcp.tc/i/awesome-copilot
More: https://mcp.tc/directory?q=github&sort=popular
